description: The sum of a natural-number list is its left fold under addition starting at \(0\), including the empty list.
signature:
List.sum_eq_foldl.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Zero α] [Add α] [Std.Associative fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2]
  [Std.LawfulIdentity (fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2) 0] {xs : List α} : xs.sum = List.foldl (fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2) 0 xs
